correctness.rationale: Writing the odd alternating bracket as (1/2)Omega(y,z)epsilon, the exact identities Omega(Py,z)+Omega(y,Pz)=tr(P)Omega(y,z), Omega(Py,Pz)=det(P)Omega(y,z) reduce the odd-odd Nijenhuis equation to det(P-lambda I)=0; the even-even equation is tautological and mixed equations cancel since L_epsilon=beta/2 after Pbeta=beta P. If mu^2!=1 the commutant is diagonal, giving (p-lambda)(s-lambda)=0 and 2q^2-q points; for mu=±1 the Q=P-lambda I singular 2x2 matrices have q^3+q^2-q points per lambda, total q^4+q^3-q^2. Independently enumerated every Nijenhuis structural solution and four ranks for all nonzero mu over F_3,F_5,F_7: exact profiles (1,2(q-1),2(q-1),(q-1)(2q-3)) off resonance and (1,(q-1)(q+1)^2,q(q^2-1),q(q-1)(q^2-2)) on resonance. Independently formed SL2(F_3), SL2(F_5) and conjugacy orbits of singular 2x2 blocks: q+2 orbits per lambda, hence q(q+2) total. Rank-one semisimple orbits indexed by nonzero trace and nilpotent split into two square classes; multiplicative point counts give the reported rational zeta factors. Analytic matrix identities support arbitrary char!=2; finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not prove infinite universality.
